title: Ember and Oath
author: Odile Sterling
blurb: Tamsin Dravenmoor, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
